description: This file defines an interface for a Window Manager component in a plugin-based system. It includes a main interface IRDKWindowManager with methods for creating displays, managing applications, handling input events, and notifications about app states, along with nested notification interface INotification. It employs virtual functions for interface inheritance and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: IRDKWindowManager
classes.description: An interface for managing window and application lifecycle events, input, display configurations, and notifications within a plugin framework.

classes.name: IRDKWindowManager::INotification
classes.description: A nested interface for receiving notifications about application state changes, activity, and visibility events.

methods.description: Registers a notification listener.
